title: Dollar Store Garbage.
text:
Dollar Store Garbage.. I ordered one and the paint was awful it looked like a five-year-old painted it.
So I got a replacement and it was just as bad.
Then I bought another one. It had the same terrible paint job.
Then I bought another one (not kidding!) and it was just as bad too.
The reason that I bought so many is because I have a Black and Tan one that I bought 10+ years ago and I wanted a red one to go with it.
After 4 I gave up!
